acceptance_criteria.text: Creating a task with a title returns 201 with an id, default status todo and default priority medium.
Creating a task without a title is rejected with 422.
Creating a task with a priority outside low/medium/high is rejected with 422.

stories.description: As a team member I can create a task with a title, optional assignee and priority, so work becomes visible to the team.

rationales.developer: Store + validation + endpoint, all new code.
rationales.sdet: Three acceptance tests incl. two rejection paths.

risks: Title validation must reject blank strings, not just missing keys.
stories.title: Create a task

acceptance_criteria.text: Listing tasks returns every created task.
Filtering by status returns only tasks in that status.
Filtering by assignee returns only that person's tasks.

stories.description: As a team member I can list tasks and filter by status or assignee, so I can see what is open and who owns it.

rationales.analyst: Filter combinations could grow; kept to two filters.
rationales.developer: Read-only query over the existing store.

stories.title: List and filter tasks

acceptance_criteria.text: Updating status to a valid value persists and is returned.
Updating status to an invalid value is rejected with 422.

stories.description: As a team member I can move a task between todo, in_progress and done, so board state reflects reality.

rationales.analyst: Same shape as create; well understood.
rationales.sdet: Two rejection paths plus the happy path.

risks: Partial updates must not wipe untouched fields.
stories.title: Update a task's status

acceptance_criteria.text: Deleting an existing task removes it from listings.

stories.description: As a team member I can delete a task that was created by mistake, so the board stays clean.

rationales.analyst: Simple delete; no cascade exists yet.
rationales.developer: Worried about cascading references from future features.

risks: No soft-delete or audit trail in this increment (PO accepted).
stories.title: Delete a task
